```lean
theorem lg_target (a b : ℕ) (h : a * b = 12) (ha : a > b) (hb : b > 2) : a = 4 := by
  have h1 : b ∈ {3, 4, 6, 12} :=
    by
      intro x
      rw [x] at h
      cases x
      exact ⟨3, 4, 6, 12⟩
  rcases h1 with (| | | |)
  · rw [h]; exact rfl
  · rw [h]; contradiction
  · rw [h]; contradiction
  · rw [h]; contradiction
```
